Brave Answers provides state-of-the-art AI-generated answers backed by verifiable sources from the web.

Part of [`seek web brave`](seek-web-brave.md).

## Usage

```text
seek web brave answers [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Answers query |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--language <code>` | Response language (default: en) |  |
| `--citations` | Request provider citation tags | `false` |
| `--entities` | Request provider entity tags | `false` |
| `--country <cc>` | Two-letter country code (e.g. US, GB) |  |
| `--json` | Emit raw JSON response |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Help
